summary: Frontend-only testing of the Patients page view toggle + Encounter view period navigator. All 12 review-request items verified as working. Default Patient view + toggle works, Encounter view defaults to Day/today (17-Aug-2026) with Today button unhighlighted, arrows shift period and highlight Today, Today button resets state, all 7 durations (Day/Week/Month/Quarter/Year/All/Custom) render the correct label format, month stepping from Aug->June 2026 correctly lists ENC-000530 (Elijah, 09-Jun) and ENC-000540 (Peter, 01-Jun), All lists 5 encounters, encounter rows navigate to /patients/<pid>/encounter/<disease>?enc=<id>, empty state shows for Day-on-today, mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390), search input persists across view toggle, role-scoped visibility works (admin=5, mary/Madang=5, joseph/own=3). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request expected Custom 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31 to show only 2 May encounters (ENC-000512, ENC-000520), but seed data in /app/frontend/src/mock/data.js contains 3 May encounters — ENC-000501 (2026-05-12), ENC-000512 (2026-05-26), ENC-000520 (2026-05-19). The UI correctly renders all 3, so this is a spec/expectation drift in the review request, not a bug. Main agent should reconcile the spec: either drop the expectation to 3 rows, or reseed ENC-000501 to a non-May date.

Patients.jsx is now 324 lines with mixed concerns (search/filter, patient card list, encounter list, period navigator). Consider extracting EncounterListView and PeriodNavigator into their own components for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container clock is 17-Aug-2026, seeded encounters are May/June 2026, so Day-on-today legitimately shows the empty state. period-select is a native <select> — use select_option. Toggle between views does NOT unmount the component so search state is preserved. Note the May Custom range returns 3 encounters (not 2 as review requested) because ENC-000501 is dated 12-May-2026 in seed data.
